reviews.text: My dogs have been a couple of times, one is very timid, so she struggled being there at first, but remembered the staff 2nd time, and has happy to stay,  they can send you pics and updates if you require 😀
The Kennels are run by two very caring sisters. The Kennels are always clean and the dogs are happy and looked after. I have been going there for at least 10 years.

Every dog owner hates leaving their dog(s) and every dog owner knows their dog well enough to learn something about the kennel they use when they pick them up. This and the fact that the owners are lovely and clearly committed to the care of their animals makes me feel better about leaving my dog.

Took my dog there from Friday - Tuesday. He was totally fine when I dropped him off. I turned up to pick him up expecting him to be fine because they had my number and made no efforts to contact me. I got him back and he had two bloody wounds in the left side of his head (neck and ear). They said he shakes his head when he’s excited, he doesn’t he shakes his head when he has irritated ears. They mentioned no efforts to treat he’s wounds on site which again were bloody red and raw. It’s now Friday and I’m still having to sooth him and stop him from scraping his wounds fresh open. I’m so angry at the state my dog came back in. He’s not himself at all and I’ll NEVER take him back there.
My dog is well looked after there.
My dog 🐕 absolutely loves going there and the girls are brilliant …
Fantastic kennels. They actually care about animals unlike all vets etc around leeds

Visited Crystal Springs for a look around before deciding whether to book.
The main reception office was so unclean and smelt of old soaked in dog urine on the link mats on the floor.
On the walk around kennels were dark and dingy. Strong old urine smell in the kennels. Days old poo in one of the runs. Wasn't pleasant at all. The runs themselves were old and dated. The whole place definitely needs a refurbishment and a serious deep clean. Stated they let the dogs out singularly four times a day which was hard to believe with such a  strong urine smell which smelt like days old and most likely soaked into the kennel floor. They are only open twice a day which doesn't match the four times a day let out into the run. I won't be booking or recommending.

As a small business ourselves we always avoid negative reviews. However, I do admit we arrived 10 minutes late (they only open 2 hours in the morning and 2 hours in the afternoon) we arrived, the conversation was. Sorry girls have left, ill …
